Applicant has invoked jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 (hereinafter referred to as "Cr.P.C.") with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 986 of 2005, under Sections 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954"), Police Station Kidwai Nagar, District Kanpur Nagar, pending before Court of learned Metropolitan Magistrate Ist, Kanpur Nagar.
3.
